title: ProbeForge: calibration validator for FP8/INT8 with metric-fusion pass/fail gates
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Build ProbeForge: an automated validation harness that runs calibration + accuracy checks for FP8/INT8 quant profiles. The harness will (1) generate calibrated profile artifacts, (2) run multi-metric validation across sampled cohorts and synthetic perturbations, and (3) emit pass/fail gates that drive canary and full rollouts. The goal is to reduce manual gating, shorten iteration time for quant rollouts, and provide explainable failure signals (layer-level sensitivity, cohort deltas, and token-level divergence traces).
acceptance_criteria: 1) Calibration job produces profile artifact and calibration metadata (scale factors/layer-sensitivity) for FP8 and INT8 variants. 2) ProbeForge evaluates a configurable set of cohorts (seeded, production-sampled, adversarial) and computes fused metrics: macro-F1 on structured tests, perplexity delta, token-level edit distance distribution, and temporal stability score. 3) Pass/fail gate rules (thresholds + weighted metric fusion) are pluggable via YAML and produce a deterministic decision. 4) Telemetry exported to Console: per-route delta, per-model layer sensitivity heatmap, and cohort-level regression dashboard. 5) Runs complete within SLA for CI gating (wall time < 45m for 5k-sample run).

decisions: Use weighted z-score fusion of normalized metrics as primary gate arithmetic (chosen 2026-01-28).
Support both synthetic adversarial cohorts and production-sampled cohorts; default run includes both (chosen 2026-01-14).
Expose adaptive thresholds based on 30-day drift quantiles; Console allows manual override and soft-fail reporting for experimental rollouts (chosen 2026-02-10).
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: calibration artifacts might differ across hardware leading to false rejections. Mitigation: record hardware fingerprint and run cross-hardware compare cluster before final gate.
Risk: metric fusion could mask regressions in a single downstream metric. Mitigation: add per-metric alerts and require explicit opt-in to ignore a metric in gate calculation.
Risk: long run times for large cohorts. Mitigation: stratified sampling with importance weighting and early-stop heuristics when delta metrics converge.
